title: Evaluation of a computed function
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates over an alphabet $\Omega$, with output alphabet $\alpha$, and let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}(n)\to\Omega)\to\alpha$. If evaluating $T$ on any input gives $f$ of that input, then for any input together with a trace equal to the sequence of coordinates queried by $T$ on that input, evaluating $T$ on the input equals $f$ of the input.
hypotheses_covered: T is a finite alphabet decision tree on n coordinates with input alphabet Ω and output alphabet α
T computes f on every input
The sample has an input and a trace
The trace equals the query sequence of T on the sample input
